issues.description: Visibility of Farm.singFarmSongVerse differs between the UML/problem statement and the solution/template. The UML in problem_statement.md lists singFarmSongVerse as private, the template declares a private method stub, but the solution implements it as protected. This mismatch can confuse students about the intended visibility and test access to this helper method.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent. Either change the solution's singFarmSongVerse to private (keeping its Animal parameter) to match the UML/template, or update the UML/problem statement and template to indicate protected if tests or external access require it. Ensure the chosen visibility is documented in the problem text so students know the intended access level.
